home.title: EASEN — Commercial Restaurant, Café & Hotel Furniture Manufacturer, Foshan China
home.desc: EASEN designs and manufactures commercial furniture in Foshan, China since 2016: restaurant chairs, booth seating, tables, café and outdoor furniture, made to order for hospitality projects worldwide.
home.hero_title: Furniture made for rooms that are full every night.
home.hero_lead: EASEN designs and builds commercial seating, booths and tables for restaurants, cafés and hotels — made to order in our 10,000 m² production base in Lecong, Foshan.
home.intro: We are a manufacturer first. Every chair, booth and table leaves our line built to your drawing — your dimensions, your fabrics, your finish — and checked piece by piece before it ships.
home.cols_title: Four families, one standard of build.
home.cols_lead: More than 330 designs in the catalogue, each available in custom sizes, upholstery and finishes.
home.proj_lead: Photographed in service, not in a showroom.
home.how_title: One team from first drawing to opening night.
home.how_lead: Hospitality projects fail in the details. These are the six we manage for you.
home.s1p: Our engineers check every dimension, clearance and fixing detail, and you sign off the final drawings before anything is cut.
home.s2p: Production runs in the same batch and process as your approved sample, with photos of the real pieces before shipment.
home.s3p: The delivery date is written into the contract and you receive weekly progress photos from the floor.
home.s4p: Crated, foam-wrapped and corner-protected. Every piece is inspected and photographed before loading.
home.s5p: Numbered parts, layout drawings and video guidance, with remote support while your team installs.
home.s6p: A dedicated after-sales contact, and free replacement parts within the warranty period.
home.factory_title: A 10,000 m² production base in Lecong, Foshan.
home.factory_lead: Frames, upholstery, finishing and packing under one roof — in the town that makes much of the world's furniture.
home.ai_title: See our furniture in your room before you order.
home.ai_lead: Upload a photo of your space, choose pieces from the EASEN collection and get a realistic preview in about 30 seconds. Free, no sign-up.
home.ai_1s: Restaurant, café or hotel — a phone photo is fine.
home.ai_2s: Choose from our real product library.
home.ai_3s: Like it? Request a quote on the spot.
home.q1: The bulk order matched the sample exactly, with pre-shipment photos of every piece. What we saw was what we got — far more reliable than our previous supplier.
home.q2: Delivered on time in 30 days, with proactive weekly progress updates. Everything was installed before opening day. The whole process was reassuring.
home.q3: Two years in, the seating is still as solid as new. On the rare issue, after-sales responded within two hours. The value far exceeded our expectations.
home.comp_title: Built for commercial use, documented for your specifier.
home.c1p: Upholstery, foam and constructions available to EN 1021-1/2, BS 5852, CAL TB 117-2013 and NFPA 260 requirements.
home.c2p: Reinforced timber or steel frames, high-density foam and contract fabrics for high-traffic dining rooms.
home.c3p: Low-VOC, low-formaldehyde options including E0/E1 panels and CARB / TSCA Title VI compliant plywood.
home.c4p: FSC / PEFC certified timber and chain-of-custody documents can be arranged for European and international projects.
home.c5p: Raw material, frame, upholstery, dimension, colour and packing checks, closing with photos of your actual pieces.
home.c6p: Test reports and certificates are supplied per project and per material — ask us for what your specification requires.
home.cta_title: Send us your drawings. We'll reply within 24 hours.
home.cta_lead: Floor plans, mood boards or a single photo are enough to start. We come back with suggested pieces, dimensions and a quotation.

about.title: About EASEN — Commercial Furniture Manufacturer in Foshan since 2016
about.desc: EASEN has manufactured commercial furniture in Lecong, Foshan since 2016. A 10,000 m² production base making restaurant, café, hotel and outdoor furniture to order.
about.h1: A furniture maker for the hospitality industry.
about.lead: Founded in 2016 in Lecong, Foshan — the heart of China's furniture industry — EASEN builds commercial furniture for restaurants, cafés, hotels and outdoor dining.
about.story_title: We don't just sell furniture. We help you get the room right.
about.story_p1: EASEN was founded in 2016 in Lecong, Foshan. Our 10,000 m² production base handles frames, upholstery, finishing and export packing, and our catalogue now covers more than 330 designs for restaurants, cafés, hotels and outdoor dining.
about.story_p2: Most of our work is made to order. Designers and operators send us drawings, references or a single photo; we develop the pieces, confirm them with samples and drawings, and build them to specification.
about.story_p3: What we care about is simple: that the pieces fit the room, match the sample, survive service — and arrive when you need them.
about.factory_title: Frames, upholstery, finishing and packing under one roof.
about.factory_lead: A walk through our production base in Lecong: timber and metal frames, upholstery, finishing, inspection and export packing.
about.why_title: What working with us looks like.
about.w1p: Production in Lecong, at the centre of China's furniture supply chain for timber, metal, foam and fabric.
about.w2p: Dimensions, colours, materials and fabrics made to your drawings, for any commercial space.
about.w3p: Seven quality checks and photos of your actual pieces before shipment.
about.w4p: Delivery date in the contract and weekly progress updates from the floor.
about.w5p: Export packing and experience shipping by sea and air, with documents for customs clearance.
about.w6p: One project contact from quotation to after-sales, reachable by email, WhatsApp or WeChat.
